_meta.purpose: GOAL-128 Kategori A orphan field migration mapping
_meta.author: Mavis
_meta.strategy: Order/event/branch orphan field'larini audit_event'e tasi. Alias entity'leri (job → job_run, cash → kasa) birlestir. Onceki yanlis entity altinda tanimlanan alanlari dogru entity'ye yonlendir.

keepAsIs.audit_event: Zaten dogru entity, orphan'lar dynamic reflection (Kategori B)
keepAsIs.security_event: Zaten dogru entity, orphan'lar dynamic reflection
keepAsIs.error_event: Zaten dogru entity, orphan'lar dynamic reflection
keepAsIs.log_retention: Zaten dogru entity, orphan'lar dynamic reflection
keepAsIs.ownership_history: Zaten dogru entity, KULLANILMIYOR (Kategori C, FAZ-12+ migration ile kaldir)

categoryB._note: Bunlar dynamic reflection ile erisilir (prisma.X.findMany + JSON.stringify). Scanner pattern'i eklenmeli, fields.yaml dokunulmamali.
